title: Returns & refunds
intro: Thirty days to return unworn pieces with tags attached. Returns within Denmark and the EU are free; elsewhere the return postage is yours.

lookup.label: Start a return
lookup.note: Your order number starts with VRL- and is in your confirmation email
lookup.enterNumber: Enter the order number from your confirmation email
lookup.notFound: We cannot find that order number

steps.label: How returns work
steps.s1Body: Enter your order number, or open the order from your account.
steps.s2Body: Choose what is going back and tell us why in one line.
steps.s3Body: Print the prepaid label. EU returns are free; elsewhere postage is yours.
steps.s4Body: Three business days from the parcel arriving, back to your original payment.

window.title: The window
window.p1: Thirty days from delivery. EU law gives you fourteen; we extend it. Sale pieces marked as final are the one exception and cannot be returned unless faulty.

condition.title: Condition
condition.p1: Unworn, unwashed, tags attached, in the original packaging. Try things on the way you would in a shop. Footwear should be tried indoors — soles that show wear cannot be accepted.

refunds.title: Refunds
refunds.method: Back to the card or wallet you paid with. We cannot refund elsewhere.
refunds.timing: Within three business days of the parcel arriving, then your bank's own delay.
refunds.shipping: Not refunded, unless a piece arrived faulty or we sent the wrong one.
refunds.discounts: A partial return recalculates the discount across the pieces you keep.

exchanges.title: Exchanges
exchanges.p1: Easiest is to return and reorder, since stock moves. If the size you want is in stock, write with the order number and we will hold it for seven days while your return travels.

digital.title: Digital products
digital.p1: Non-refundable once downloaded, since there is nothing to send back. If a file will not open, write to us and we will fix it or refund it.

faults.title: Faults and repairs
faults.p1: Two years on manufacturing faults, and free repair in that time. After two years the Copenhagen studio still repairs any VAREL piece, charged at cost. Send a photograph first and we will tell you what it needs.
